name: reset-dependence-runs
alternateName: Reset Dependence Is Embodied: run summaries
description: Run summaries behind the NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets paper 'Reset Dependence Is Embodied: Training Protocol Changes Which Morphologies Appear Optimal'. The 100 training bodies of MetaMorph's UNIMAL-100 benchmark, which MetaMorph chose from the UNIMAL bodies that DERL evolved, were trained with PPO for 5M environment steps under fall rules that end a training episode when the torso drops below a fraction tau of its reset height (Reset-free tau = 0, Standard tau = 0.20, Strict tau = 0.50, plus 0.10 and 0.35), with seeds 42, 43 and 44, and each controller was scored over 20 episodes by three evaluators. The dataset holds one JSON summary per run for the 900-run corpus, the other UNIMAL panels and the stopped existing-robot panel (3,306 runs in all, including the SAC, retraining, time-limit, contact-termination, non-evolved-body and longer-budget panels), a flat CSV of all runs, structural features of the bodies, the zero-action and probe simulation records, joint-angle traces of nine illustrative controllers, and training logs where they were kept. No policy checkpoints are included. The UNIMAL body files are not included; the code repository downloads them from the upstream release and checks their hashes. With the CPU scripts in the code repository these files recompute the statistics and figures that the paper reports for the UNIMAL panels. The numbers script recomputes 2,401 values, and the end of its report (records/camera_ready_numbers.md) lists the printed numbers it does not recompute with their sources: mostly settings, dates, decision rules and quoted values, plus results kept outside the run summaries such as the cross-validated structure fits. panels.zip holds the five control panels trained during the review discussion outside the UNIMAL corpus (5,860 cells): Humanoid fall rules, Humanoid time-limit handling, Ant reset initialization, Ant protocol breadth (reset initialization, time-limit handling, observation noise) and Evolution Gym time-limit handling. It holds one CSV row per morphology, protocol, seed and hardware class with the score each frozen report ranks, the Humanoid evaluation curves, and the frozen reports, panel specifications, contracts and inventories; scripts/review_panels.py in the code repository recomputes every statistic and cell count in those reports from the tables.
rai:dataCollection: All records were produced by the authors in simulation. The run summaries in runs.zip come from GPU PPO and SAC training in MuJoCo MJX in April 2026, and the zero-action and probe records were produced on CPU on 2026-10-05. The review-period panels in panels.zip were trained between 25 July and 1 August 2026 (Brax PPO in MuJoCo MJX for Humanoid and Ant, Stable-Baselines3 PPO in Evolution Gym). No human subjects or personal data are involved.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Run summaries are the JSON files written by the training scripts, unchanged except that GPU host names are replaced by stable pseudonyms (gpu-node-NN) and home directories in recorded paths are masked. Job ids and code commits are kept. The CSV tables are flattened copies of the JSON summaries and morphology features. The review-period panel tables (panels.zip) copy a fixed list of fields from each run's raw records, with no host names or paths; every score equals the one the panel's frozen report used. The frozen reports are copied unchanged except for one masked design-note path in the Evolution Gym report, and the panel specifications are shipped without their root binding tokens and storage locations, as in the reports.
rai:dataLimitations: Two defects in the fall thresholds (described in the paper): the Standard cutoff lies below the torso radius for 28 bodies, and the Strict cutoff ends episodes during the reset drop for ten VT bodies (an eleventh body, from the Floor family, is cut off without an identified mechanism). The corpus, intermediate-tau and SAC records do not store the code version, full settings or GPU. No checkpoints of the UNIMAL runs were saved. Results hold for one task (forward locomotion), one PPO preset and three seeds. The review-period panels are small (20 to 30 bodies per pool, four or five seeds), use other trainers, budgets and evaluators than the UNIMAL panels, and the two arms of the Humanoid time-limit panel were trained with different code revisions.
rai:dataBiases: The 100 bodies are MetaMorph's selection from the bodies that DERL evolved and are not a random sample of designs. Family sizes are unequal (41 Floor, 37 VT, 22 MVT).
rai:dataUseCases: Recomputing the paper's statistics; studying how training-protocol choices change morphology rankings; benchmarking reporting practices in co-design. Not suitable for training or deploying controllers on hardware.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Low. The data describe simulated locomotion and contain no personal information.
rai:dataCollectionMissingData: No checkpoints of the UNIMAL runs were saved. No training logs exist for the corpus and SAC runs. The corpus, intermediate-tau and SAC summaries do not record the code commit, full settings or GPU. For the review-period panels, the raw run records, policy checkpoints and generated body files are not included (the tables keep the SHA-256 of each raw result and configuration file and of each body); the Ant breadth panel's report.json was not kept, so its frozen summary table is shipped instead, and its table lacks the evaluation details, body hashes, wall times and job ids. The A2C panel records are not included.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Versioned GitHub releases of the code repository; corrections are published as new releases with a changelog in the data card.

prov:wasDerivedFrom.name: UNIMAL-100 benchmark of MetaMorph (training set chosen from the bodies evolved by DERL)
prov:wasDerivedFrom.description: The 100 UNIMAL training bodies of the UNIMAL-100 benchmark (unimals_100/train/xml) that the evolved-body panels train on (Gupta, Fan, Ganguli and Fei-Fei, ICLR 2022). MetaMorph chose them from the bodies that DERL evolved (Gupta, Savarese, Ganguli and Fei-Fei, Nature Communications 12, 5721, 2021). The upstream repository declares no license, so the files are not included. The code repository downloads them and checks their SHA-256.

prov:wasDerivedFrom.name: DERL code base (UNIMAL generator)
prov:wasDerivedFrom.description: Generator used to sample the 60 non-evolved bodies (gen-*) of the non_evolved panel. The repository declares no license; the generated XMLs are not included, only their features and run summaries.

prov:wasDerivedFrom.name: MuJoCo Menagerie robot models
prov:wasDerivedFrom.description: MJX models of Unitree Go2, ANYbotics ANYmal C, ToddlerBot 2XC and Unitree G1 used by the existing_robots panel. Not included; each model keeps its own license in the Menagerie repository.

prov:wasDerivedFrom.name: Gymnasium MuJoCo Ant and Humanoid models
prov:wasDerivedFrom.description: The parametric Ant and Humanoid bodies of the review-period panels were generated by scaling the limbs of Gymnasium's Ant and Humanoid MuJoCo models. The generated body files are not included; the tables record the SHA-256 of each.

prov:wasDerivedFrom.name: Evolution Gym
prov:wasDerivedFrom.description: Walker-v0 and BridgeWalker-v0 tasks and the voxel bodies of the Evolution Gym panel (Bhatia et al., NeurIPS 2021). The body definitions are not included; the tables record the SHA-256 of each.

prov:wasGeneratedBy.name: Controller training and evaluation
prov:wasGeneratedBy.description: PPO (and, for one panel, SAC) training of one controller per body, rule and seed in MuJoCo MJX on GPUs of a SLURM cluster, followed by CPU MuJoCo evaluation over 20 episodes with three evaluators (PPO actions sampled, SAC actions deterministic). Each run wrote one JSON summary. The 900-run corpus was trained in several launches from 5 to 8 April 2026, and the other panels of runs.zip later in April 2026. Trainers: corpus_revision/ and scripts/ in the code repository.

prov:wasGeneratedBy.name: Review-period control panels
prov:wasGeneratedBy.description: Training of the Humanoid, Ant and Evolution Gym panels during the review discussion, between 25 July and 1 August 2026: Brax PPO in MuJoCo MJX on GH200 and H100 GPUs for Humanoid and Ant, Stable-Baselines3 PPO on CPU for Evolution Gym. Each panel's cells, comparisons and analysis settings were fixed in a specification and contract before its analysis was run, and a frozen analysis wrote one report per panel (the Humanoid time-limit report is a composite of two panels). Scores and file hashes of the Ant breadth panel were recovered from its raw records on 2026-09-24.

prov:wasGeneratedBy.name: Simulation probe records
prov:wasGeneratedBy.description: CPU MuJoCo zero-action rollouts, settle heights, random-action searches and training-like torso probes of the UNIMAL bodies (sim-records/), made with records/sim-record-scripts/ in the code repository.

prov:wasGeneratedBy.name: Packaging and masking
prov:wasGeneratedBy.description: GPU host names replaced by stable pseudonyms (gpu-node-NN), home directories and the UNIMAL XML directory masked in recorded paths and logs, empty lock files dropped, the JSON summaries and morphology features flattened into tables/runs.csv and tables/morph_features.csv, and the archives written with fixed timestamps so that the build is byte-reproducible. Apart from this masking, the run summaries are unchanged. For panels.zip, a fixed list of fields was copied from each run's raw records into the CSV tables (no host names or paths), every score was checked against the frozen report that used it, root binding tokens and storage locations were removed from the panel specifications as the frozen reports do, and one internal design-note path was masked in two specifications, the composite specification and the Evolution Gym report.
